prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "explore this unfamiliar dataset". The evidence packet contains missingness, duplicates, unit ambiguity, and an attractive aggregate that can change the unit of analysis. The acceptance boundary is exploratory-data-analysis: Identify provenance, observation unit, schema, units, missingness, censoring, duplication, selection, time coverage, and transformations. The adjacent analytics-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: timestamped readings from multiple sensors, machines, shifts, and production batches
known injected missing interval and one recalibrated sensor to validate discovery
raw units/metadata plus an intentionally undocumented outlier cluster
reproducible notebook/script output with data-quality profile and candidate hypotheses
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual exploratory-data-analysis boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=data-analysis; near-neighbor=analytics-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Identify provenance, observation unit, schema, units, missingness, censoring, duplication, selection, time coverage, and transformations.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Quality profile; Reproducible transformations; Exploratory findings
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of exploratory-data-analysis correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Quality profile; Reproducible transformations; Exploratory findings; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
